event.description: Share one output row of the second attention head across depth
event.proposal: family: attention organization; current retained incumbent is 2739 parameters at 99.7000%, a +0.70 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family most recent accepted result: attempt-0070, sharing three query output rows across depth at 2739 parameters and 99.70%; same-family most recent failed result: attempt-0072, sharing one MQA K/V output row at 2725 parameters and 0.02%; prior attempts in this family: 19. Hypothesis: preserve the three qualified query-row ties and the shared head-0 output map, but share only one 7-value output row of head 1's otherwise independent 7x7 map across depth, leaving its remaining six output rows block-specific. This removes 7 parameters for a target of 2732. It is more informative than repeating the failed full K/V-row tie or the earlier full second-head output tie at the same total count because it isolates a minimal post-attention redundancy in the remaining head and tests a finer boundary. Keep d14/h2/L2 MQA, ff23 with one within-block tied hidden unit shared across blocks, rank8 positions, two final group scales, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy at least 99% and strictly fewer parameters than the incumbent.
